text:
𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧 𝗙𝗜𝗙𝗧𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗜𝗡 𝗣𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜! 🇵🇰

Pakistan declare on 434/9; Tayyab Arif made 57 off 51 on debut, Shakeel 93.
Sri Lanka 114/3, trail by 320.

Super start 👏

#Cricket #PAKvSL

𝗣𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗗𝗘𝗕𝗨𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧𝗦 𝗞𝗔 𝗞𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗔𝗟! 🇵🇰🔥

👉 Pakistan 434/9 pe declare, Sri Lanka 114/3 (320 se peeche)
👉 Tayyab Arif ne debut par 51 gend mein 57 banaye
👉 Saud Shakeel 93 pe out, century se 7 run door
👉 Debutant Saqib Khan ko 2/54

Kya Pakistan ye Test jeet payega? Comment karo 👇
